title: Product model
outcome: One living map of the product: an ontology that defines what a product is made of, a model defined and managed as it grows, a link to the work, and a source of new ideas and experiments.
why: GitOps records changes but doesn't know what the product is. The model keeps intent connected to the product after the work closes. This is where intent-driven comes alive.
proof: A person changes the ontology through one play and the model still passes its checks.
Any part can be added, changed or removed.
From any intent, you can list what serves it.
The model proposes an idea with its evidence, a person confirms it, and an experiment records the result.
must_not: Block work because the model is incomplete, let an agent confirm an intent, or name a plan.

touches.title: Define what a product is made of
Write down what a product is made of: the kinds, what each holds, how they link, the rules and a real example of each
Change the map through one play, one need at a time, with the product owner's yes at three points
Bring the current map to every project
Keep every part that reads the map in step with it: the page templates, the index's schema, the structure check and the glossary
Run the model's checks before and after every change to the map, and show what the change breaks, as findings, never a stop
Record which version of the map a model is built to, so an upgrade knows what to move
Let a team extend the map, with the plays changed with it
Define the product profile and the product decision as kinds of the map
Define the approval state each kind carries
Manage the model
Add a part found during work, with its page and its index entry
Change a part from words a person approved
Take a part out on a person's named approval
Link the parts by the map's rules: what each serves, what it needs and what led us to find it
Say whether work can start on each part: ready, partly ready or not ready, with the gaps
Check the model's structure and links on every change, as findings, never a stop
Find and close the gaps inside the model
List what serves an intent, and what sits in a domain
Keep each part's approval state, so agents build only from approved parts
Move the model with the work
Change the model's index only through the two index skills
Create and edit the model with one tool that knows its shape
Propose what to try next from the model, and record each experiment's result
